# men-pack

> Interactive and automation-friendly scaffolding CLI for Node.js backend APIs.

men-pack supports Express, Fastify, and NestJS; MongoDB, PostgreSQL, and SQLite; and JavaScript or TypeScript. It creates local project files and does not call an LLM or remote service.

## Documentation

- [Documentation index](docs/README.md): all user and maintainer guides.
- [Getting started](docs/getting-started.md): install and run the CLI.
- [CLI reference](docs/cli-reference.md): commands, options, aliases, and JSON mode.
- [CLI result JSON Schema](docs/schemas/cli-result.schema.json): structured CLI response contract.
- [Supported stacks](docs/supported-stacks.md): generated layouts, configuration, defaults, and limitations.
- [Resource generation](docs/resource-generation.md): endpoint behavior and generated tests.
- [AI agent and RAG usage](docs/ai-agents.md): machine-readable CLI examples and safe automation guidance.
- [CI and npm publishing](docs/ci-and-publishing.md): checks and release workflow.
- [Agent repository instructions](AGENTS.md): source map and contribution checks.

## Machine interface

For automation, use `men-pack init <name> --framework <framework> --database <database> --language <language> --json` or `men-pack generate <resource> --json`. JSON is written to stdout; errors return a non-zero status and a JSON error on stderr.
